source_row.rationale: Rinsing the mouth with water before sputum collection helps reduce contamination of the sample with oral flora (bacteria normally present in the mouth), improving the accuracy of culture results in reflecting the actual respiratory pathogen responsible for the client's condition.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose of Mouth Rinsing Before Sputum Collection
source_row.source_name: Clinical Microbiology References — Sputum Collection Technique
